canonical_name: do-mpc -- Model Predictive Control toolbox (TU Dortmund)
lineage: do-mpc (2016-, Fiedler/Lucia et al.): nonlinear and robust Model Predictive Control -- at each step solve a finite-horizon optimal-control problem over a model, apply the first input, re-solve (receding horizon); built on CasADi/IPOPT
version: github.com/do-mpc/do-mpc master as of 2026-09-12 (commit in hashes)
build_system: pip install do-mpc casadi (heavy; NOT built this pass)
entry_points: do_mpc.controller.MPC over a do_mpc.model; the receding-horizon loop

example.command: SOURCE ONLY this pass -- the CasADi/IPOPT stack is a heavy install deferred
example.output: the predicted-optimal input sequence, first step applied

environment.runner: none this pass -- SOURCE pinned; CasADi/IPOPT build deferred (RUNNABLE_CONTAINER candidate)

upstream_docs: Rawlings, Mayne, Diehl, Model Predictive Control: Theory, Computation, and Design

human_capability_summary.built_to: control a constrained dynamical system by repeatedly solving, at each step, a finite-horizon optimisation over a model of the plant and applying only the first move -- anticipating the future and respecting constraints
human_capability_summary.pressure: hard constraints (actuator/state limits) and a plant where greedy feedback violates them; the controller must look ahead and re-plan as reality diverges from the model
human_capability_summary.success_means: constraint-respecting control that optimises a horizon cost and re-plans fast enough to run in real time

known_human_problem_solved: constrained predictive control by receding-horizon optimisation
human_environmental_pressure: hard state/actuator constraints, model mismatch, a real-time solve deadline
human_failure_condition: the horizon optimisation is infeasible or too slow -> the controller stalls or violates a constraint (a physical limit is breached)
behavioral_entry_point: tighten a constraint or shorten the solve deadline until the receding-horizon problem becomes infeasible

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run do-mpc
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: control a constrained dynamical system by repeatedly solving, at each step, a finite-horizon optimisation over a model of the plant and applying only the first move -- anticipating the future and respecting constraints
